entities.name: Khyyiani
entities.description: One of the four tribes of cheetah-like cat warriors in the Sukurvian Desert, with a fierce warrior culture.

entities.name: Sukurvian Desert
entities.description: Desert where the cat warrior tribes live in oases.

entities.name: Efravans
entities.description: Tiger-like cat people who consider the Khyyiani battle-mad and cruel.

entities.name: Efrava
entities.description: Homeland of the Efravans, four days' walk southwest of the Khyyiani.

entities.name: Terrent Amese
entities.description: Said to have created the original tribe to guard the Dark Heart of the Wood.

entities.name: Dark Heart of the Wood
entities.description: Place guarded by the original tribe.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: Came to recruit the Khyyiani against Johan in 3336 AR.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: Enemy with an incoming airship army.

entities.name: Kyyrao Grrenmw
entities.description: One of five Khyyiani who made it to northern Aerona.

events.summary: Jedit Ojanen visits the Khyyiani oasis to recruit them against Johan; they vehemently refuse.

relations.note: created the original tribe from which they descend, per myth
relations.quote: which, according to myth, was created by Terrent Amese to guard the Dark Heart of the Wood

relations.note: Efravans call them cruel and battle-mad
relations.quote: being referred to as "battle-mad" by the Efravans
